284832960.description: This lot includes a foam display tray with 19 labeled glass cork-top vials filled with tumbled chip stones such as Jade, Lapis Lazuli, Smoky Quartz, Aquamarine, Rhodonite, Fluorite, Amethyst, Red Jasper, and Clear Quartz. Also featured is a green aventurine gua sha stone and a decorative silver-tone spoon with a carved green stone handle. The pieces show natural wear consistent with mineral specimens and some contain dirt or matrix residue typical of raw stones.

Natural Polished Crystal Sphere
Polished Mineral Display Orb
Natural Gemstone, Approximately 4.8 Inches, 5.7 Pounds
This substantial natural crystal sphere is polished into a smooth, spherical orb showcasing internal veining, natural cleavage planes, and mineral inclusions throughout. Carved and polished mineral spheres have long been prized as focal decorative objects, meditation centerpieces, and geological display specimens. Its soft translucent tone and complex internal landscape reflect light from multiple angles, highlighting its unique natural formation.
Solid natural polished mineral crystal sphere
Translucent pale body with intricate internal fractures, veining, and natural matrix inclusions
Substantial weight of approximately 5.7 pounds
Smooth hand-polished exterior surface ideal for display or collection
Condition:
The outer surface is smoothly polished with high luster. Natural internal fissures, planes, and organic inclusions are inherent to the mineral formation and present throughout. Minor surface variations and tiny natural pits consistent with hand-polished raw gemstone specimens. No post-production chips or breaks observed.
